description: NaY₃SiS₇ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃ space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent S atoms to form face-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.70 Å) and three longer (2.72 Å) Na-S bond lengths. Y is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight S atoms. There are a spread of Y-S bond distances ranging from 2.79-3.21 Å. Si is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four S atoms. There is one shorter (2.12 Å) and three longer (2.15 Å) Si-S bond lengths. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and four equivalent Y atoms. In the second S site, S is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three equivalent Y and one Si atom. In the third S site, S is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to three equivalent Y and one Si atom.
